messages:
Mina: Follow-up from the KV shard instability postmortem. Goal: lock owners & deadlines for remediation -> test additions. We saw recurring spikes tied to nightly batch window + occasional deploys. Need: a regression promptset + a reproducible load scenario with TTL overrides + a controlled chaos drill that validates fallback routing and warm-cache strategies.

Josh: Split it into lanes: (1) fast CI guard (promptset + fingerprint), (2) verification load job with TTL override and kill-switch, (3) safety drill + post-drill runbook.

Carla: I'll curate the regression promptset. Plan: 6 seeds pulled from traces (cold-start, batching-aligned, many-short, long-context, streaming edge, retry-heavy). Will add metadata tag "eviction_fingerprint:v2". ETA: PR by end of week (Thu).

Sam: I'll write the k6 harness for the load scenario. Scenario: 60->1600 rps ramp over 8m, a gated stage that posts TTL overrides via ops API, and a kill-switch that stops the job if token cost >2.5x baseline. Need the exact request mix from traces. @Josh can you attach the slice?

Josh: Attached trace window: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict and ops snapshot in TICKET-4821. Noted batch-job alignment at 02:30 UTC.

Mina: Acceptance for promptset: should flag a regression if p99 increases >15% OR token generation cost >2x vs our baseline within CI. Place prompts under evals/incidents/kv-shard-flap/ and run nightly. Add a short triage doc for the eviction_fingerprint.

Carla: I'll include expected outputs and an automated comparison harness. Will also add streaming/non-stream variants and a small local runner. PR will reference TICKET-5607 and open sub-ticket TICKET-5608 for promptset.

Sam: TTL override snippet I'll include (gated behind feature flag & prechecks):

curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://ops-api.internal/shards/override-ttl \
  -d '{"shard_group":7,"ttl_seconds":20}'

I'll ensure the k6 pipeline has a preflight that checks cluster healthy and a kill-switch that aborts if cache-miss rate >6% for 2m. Sub-ticket: TICKET-5609 (load harness).

ops-bot: Created TICKET-5607 "kv-shard-flap: regression promptset + load + drill" assigned Carla, Sam, Josh. Due 2026-06-04.

QA-bot: Nightly eval job configured: evals/incidents/kv-shard-flap runs 03:00 UTC; failures post to #eng-platform and create a regression issue in the evals dashboard.

Aisha: Product/solutions: please confirm whether any promptset failures require direct user communication or just rollout gating. Will follow up on PR.

Josh: For the chaos drill: tabletop Tue, live Wed next sprint. Tabletop deliverables: scenario doc, rollback steps, observable asserts (cache miss %, regen token cost, request error rates), and a contact matrix. Live drill requires a rehearsed staging run first.

Carla: I'll draft the scenario doc and checklist by Monday. Will include acceptance criteria for CI gating and triage steps.

Sam: I'll rehearse the k6+TTL flow in staging and publish the safe-playbook with a one-command kill-switch. Will also codify pass criteria: under synthetic spike p95 < baseline_p95 * 1.2 and token cost <2x.

Josh: I'll add monitoring rules: sustained cache-miss >4% for 3m -> page SRE; eviction_fingerprint spikes should create an internal signal in the evals dashboard. I'll also publish the trace snippets for easier replay. Sub-ticket: TICKET-5610 (monitoring).

Mina: Owners recap and timelines: Carla = promptset PR (TICKET-5608) by Thu; Sam = k6 + TTL stage + playbook (TICKET-5609) by next Tue; Josh = monitoring + traces (TICKET-5610) by Mon. Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed next sprint. I'll write the post-drill writeup and update the postmortem with links and lessons.

Carla: Will ping Product (Aisha) in the PR for rollout impact review.

Mina: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until TICKET-5607 is In Progress. Ping here if anything slips or if we need more throttle on the live drill.
